paragraphs: Lightbox Learning sells classroom and library solutions built from curriculum-aligned digital titles for educators and students. The classroom range is described as multisensory experiences that engage all learning styles. The library range is presented as material to help students become independent thinkers.

Titles are sold by subscription, and one library nonfiction subscription is listed with 851 titles and new titles added during the term. Print is part of the same offer, since all Lightbox and AV2 titles are available as a media enhanced hardcover book. A book code printed inside a purchased book opens the interactive version.

Site navigation lists subscriber resources for schools and public libraries. A separate Lightbox at Home website covers online learning solutions for homeschoolers. Testimonials on the site are attributed to schools and public libraries, including Brunswick County Library, VA.

quote.text: At Lightbox Learning, our mission is to create high-quality, curriculum-aligned classroom and library solutions that empower educators and inspire students.
